rollback_plan: Before merge: nothing is deployed and the live-mode runs only refuse (exit 3), so there is no runtime rollback. After merge: git revert --no-edit <merge-sha> on main, then python3 ci/gates/run_all.py. Expected recovery time: about 10 minutes (estimate, not measured). No schema or data migration. The endpoint guard, httpx log level, G-7 checks, gate text and realized-basis halt return to their previous behavior.

claims.claim: The RPC endpoint guard refuses an endpoint with userinfo, a key-named query parameter or an opaque key-shaped path segment at config load. The ConfigError names the setting and never echoes the secret.
Clean keyless https and wss endpoints and the default endpoint are still accepted, and non-TLS endpoints are still refused.
httpx and httpcore INFO request lines that carry a secret URL are not written, and WARNING lines still reach the sink.
On the realized basis the daily-loss halt uses day-start equity plus realized P&L: cash deployed into a position and an unrealized swing alone do not halt, and a realized loss at the floor does.

The defects reproduce before the fix: on origin/main code, 21 of the 34 tests fail (userinfo and key-parameter refusals, httpx and httpcore INFO logging, realized-basis halt). The 13 that pass there are non-regression cases.
The live gate prints the wallet allowlist as wallet.allowlist, the real setting key. The gate text and its two pins are renamed, and the live-gate tests pass.
In a clean checkout with no var/, each of the nine gate lines printed by the live refusal appears in docs/LIVE_READINESS.md with the same precondition id, state and text, for all nine rows.
In a clean checkout the live refusal exits 3 by design, with eight preconditions unmet and row 6 met.
The refusal does not create var/ledger.sqlite in a clean checkout, so rows 3 and 4 keep the no-ledger text there.
In the l1-risk worktree, where var/ledger.sqlite exists, rows 3 and 4 print no source=paper events in var/ledger.sqlite, and LIVE_READINESS.md says so.
PUMPGROK_RPC__API_KEY is documented in .env.example as an empty placeholder, and the placeholder and docs tests pass.
